reviews_captured_by_me.text: We hired Oak Lane to help us tear down an old deck, build new steps, and install a new fence. Cameron was very friendly and professional and easy to work with. He kept us informed on how long the job was taking and progress. Would definitely recommend his work to others. Fair pricing and hard working!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

We couldn’t be happier with the work **Oak Lane Remodeling** did on our steps! The before and after speaks for itself. 🙌

Our old steps were definitely showing their age, and they completely transformed them. They look **clean, fresh, sturdy, and brand new again!** The attention to detail and quality of the work really shows.

Professional, dependable, and did an amazing job from start to finish. We would absolutely recommend **Oak Lane Remodeling** to anyone looking to have work done on their home.

Thank you for giving our back entrance such a much-needed makeover! ❤️.

I have had several projects done by Cameron over the last year and a half. He has done my kitchen backsplash and has built a new gate. Cameron shows a high level of knowledge and expertise when it comes to remodeling projects and overall home repair maintenance that gives me confidence that my money is well spent every time he finishes a project. I am thrilled based on how well it looks I only does Cameron do small projects but he also does much larger remodels like basement kitchen and bathroom if you’re getting any work done to your house I would highly encourage you to reach out to Oaklane remodeling and you will see Cameron’s kindness in how he does his work.
